attributes.action: Keep the 10 years long residency for people already in the UK
attributes.background: The government should take into consideration the concept of legitimate expectation and article 8 human, changing the goalpost in the middle is unfair, unlawful, un-British and abuse of power. And should consider the people who made a major life decision based on the current law

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Keep 10-year Long Residence Route for people already living in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781255
